title.narrative: Conflict Transformation in the Middle East

description.narrative: The project aims to foster new, inclusive policy-relevant alternatives for addressing conflicts in the Middle East. The project seeks to bring about new ideas towards the resolution of conflicts by considering the diverse worldviews, both secular and religious, held by key stakeholders. The project engages inclusively with diverse regional stakeholders (political, security, civil society, business sector, and religious elites), as well as international ones, to establish sustainable communication channels and promote tangible actions, which take into account diverse worldviews. Through knowledge development, political advocacy, and geopolitical economic initiatives, the project contributes to generating more effective frameworks for future arrangements and agreements, in alignment with international law, ultimately aiming to enhance the legitimacy and sustainability of conflict transformation efforts.
